milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak door is at spawn-relative position [1, 1, 4] on the front wall of the structure. The player must navigate near it and face it to 'find' it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model the player being able to see the door.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch button drops the birch_button item into the player's inventory. Buttons break instantly by hand (no tool needed) and always drop themselves. The button is on the back interior wall at ~1,~2,~11.

Uses inventory_has because mining chiseled_stone_bricks with a pickaxe (provided via /give) drops the block as an item into inventory. The player starts with a stone_pickaxe which is required for this block to drop. Three chiseled_stone_bricks are on the left interior wall at ~-3,~1-2,~7-8.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The azure_bluet flower is at spawn-relative position [-3, 1, 3] in the garden area to the left of the structure entrance. The player must navigate near it and face it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model the player being able to see the flower.
